maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufacturing and selling new RVs (Airstream, Jayco, Heartland, Thor Motor Coach) to dealers, not repair or aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: New RVs are sold through dealers to consumers who pay privately for recreation; government is not the final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew via some large acquisitions (Jayco, Heartland, Erwin Hymer) but mainly grows by selling its RV brands; deals occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers and consumers can switch among competing RV brands easily; discretionary recreational vehicles with no integration or regulatory lock-in.
